title: Inconsistent editor warnings for ternary operator
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in **v4.4.1.stable.official**,  _v4.5.beta3.official_

### System information

Fedora Linux 42 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition)

### Issue description

The editor shows inconsistent warnings with the following additional debug warnings enabled (which are by default ignored):
```
gdscript/warnings/untyped_declaration=1
gdscript/warnings/inferred_declaration=1
gdscript/warnings/unsafe_property_access=1
gdscript/warnings/unsafe_method_access=1
gdscript/warnings/unsafe_cast=1
gdscript/warnings/unsafe_call_argument=1
```

```GDScript
func _return_string(variant: Variant) -> String:
	if variant is String: # Code completion works because of this.
		return "Empty" if variant.is_empty() else variant # UNSAFE_METHOD_ACCESS; has code completion
	return ""


func _return_string_no_code_completion(variant: Variant) -> String:
	match typeof(variant): # Code completion doesn't work because of this.
		TYPE_STRING:
			return "Empty" if variant.is_empty() else variant # UNSAFE_METHOD_ACCESS; no code completion
	return ""


func _return_cast_string(variant: Variant) -> String:
	if variant is String:
		return "Empty" if (variant as String).is_empty() else variant # UNSAFE_CAST; has code completion
	return ""


func _return_converted_string(variant: Variant) -> String:
	if variant is String:
		return "Empty" if str(variant).is_empty() else variant # OK; has code completion
	return ""


func _return_type_converted_string(variant: Variant) -> String:
	if variant is String:
		return "Empty" if type_convert(variant, TYPE_STRING).is_empty() else variant # UNSAFE_METHOD_ACCESS; no code completion
	return ""


func _return_non_ternary_string(variant: Variant) -> String:
	if variant is String:
		var string: String = variant
		return "Empty" if string.is_empty() else string # OK; has code completion
	return ""


func _return_non_ternary_cast(variant: Variant) -> String:
	if variant is String:
		var string: String = variant as String # UNSAFE_CAST
		return "Empty" if string.is_empty() else string # OK; has code completion
	return ""


func _return_non_ternary_conversion(variant: Variant) -> String:
	if variant is String:
		var string: String = str(variant) # OK
		return "Empty" if string.is_empty() else string # OK; has code completion
	return ""


func _return_non_ternary_type_converted(variant: Variant) -> String:
	if variant is String:
		var string: String = type_convert(variant, TYPE_STRING) # OK
		return "Empty" if string.is_empty() else string # OK; no code completion
	return ""
```

Doing an `if Variant is String` check before accesing a variable will enable code completion and ensure type safety. Using `typeof(Variant)` in a match statement will not enable code completion, which is to be expected.

However, even after doing the if type check, and even though code completion works, the editor will throw an UNSAFE_METHOD_ACCESS warning.
This can be avoided by converting the Variant to a String using `str()`. Other methods of conversion / casting such as `Variant as String` and `type_convert()` will throw an UNSAFE_CAST and UNSAFE_METHOD_ACCESS respectively.

This only happens when doing the casting inside the ternary operator, with one exception also included above:
```GDScript
func _return_non_ternary_cast(variant: Variant) -> String:
	if variant is String:
		var string: String = variant as String # UNSAFE_CAST
		return "Empty" if string.is_empty() else string # OK; has code completion
	return ""
```

### Steps to reproduce

Download the MRP. It already has the code above and the warnings enabled. Otherwise, enable the warnings mentioned and copy the code above.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[warnings.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21140358/warnings.zip)
